description: Source code for a Wear OS watch face service demonstrating complications, drawing watch hands, handling tap events, and managing background images.

classes.name: ComplicationSimpleWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, managing watch face lifecycle and complications.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling drawing, updates, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes background, complications, and watch face style.

methods.name: initializeBackground
methods.description: Loads background bitmap and sets paint color.

methods.name: initializeComplication
methods.description: Sets up complication data structures and activates complications.

methods.name: initializeWatchFace
methods.description: Sets default colors, initializes paint objects, and extracts palette colors.

methods.name: onComplicationDataUpdate
methods.description: Updates complication data when new data arrives.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, detects if a complication was tapped.

methods.name: getTappedComplicationId
methods.description: Determines if tap was inside a complication area.

methods.name: onComplicationTap
methods.description: Handles tap on a complication, executing associated PendingIntent or requesting permission.

methods.name: updateWatchHandStyle
methods.description: Updates paint styles based on ambient mode.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface size changes, recalculates positions and scales background.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background, complications, and watch hands.

methods.name: drawBackground
methods.description: Draws either background bitmap or black in ambient mode.

methods.name: drawComplications
methods.description: Renders complication data on the watch face.

methods.name: drawWatchFace
methods.description: Draws clock hands and tick marks.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the update handler based on visibility and mode.

methods.name: shouldTimerBeRunning
methods.description: Determines if the update timer should run.
